opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members (and Undergraduate & Masters members for Society meetings). Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend a Society and/or Society-sponsored conference. Covers registration and meeting dinners, with a contribution toward travel and accommodation up to the total value of the award. Members can apply to attend up to three meetings with one application.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: The Physiological Society members. Applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: The Physiological Society members. Applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: The Paton Historical Studies Fund
opportunities.summary: Small grants to promote research or engagement activities in the history of modern physiology.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional support to help postdoctoral researchers achieve their full potential, enhancing their commitment to physiology and benefiting the wider community of physiologists.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership, or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address Equity, Diversity and Inclusion principles in the physiological sciences, in teaching or research.
